edges.carries: the full text of the landlord notices
the list of proposed changes to rent standing order fields
the changes that are authorized, with the notice text that supports each one
the changes that were rejected and the reason for each
the field-by-field changes the user approved
the outcome of each applied change

nodes.name: ReadNotices
nodes.role: read the landlord notices file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractInstructions
nodes.role: pull out each instruction the notices give about the rent standing order

nodes.name: CheckAuthority
nodes.role: confirm each instruction comes from the landlord and is within the change the user asked for

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user each proposed change to the rent standing order and get their approval

nodes.name: ApplyChanges
nodes.role: change only the approved fields of the rent standing order

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user which changes were made, which were skipped, and why
